# TypeRB

> TypeRB is an alpha, statically typed programming language that compiles one portable source grammar to Go, Ruby, and TypeScript.

TypeRB source uses canonical, case-sensitive type names and explicit imports. Target-specific APIs require `trb/platform/<mode>/*`. Prefer the linked documentation over inferring TypeRB behavior from a target language.

## Learn

- [Getting started](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/getting-started/): Install TypeRB and run a first standalone or project program.
- [Learning TypeRB](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/learning/): The shortest path from installation to a small application.
- [Language guide](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/language/): Practical syntax and semantics with examples.
- [A Tour of TypeRB](https://type-rb.github.io/tour/): Executable browser lessons.

## Reference

- [Language specification](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/specification/): The normative language reference.
- [Standard library](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/standard-library/): Portable standard packages and APIs.
- [Command-line interface](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/cli/): Commands, options, and workflows.
- [Project configuration](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/configuration/): `trbconfig.jsonc` and backend configuration.
- [Lint rules](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/lint-rules/): Built-in maintainability rules and their stable identifiers.
- [TypeRB 1.0 capability map](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/capabilities/): Revisable proposed 1.0 coverage with available, partial, planned, and exploring states.

## Build applications

- [Web applications](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/guides/web/): Portable routing, requests, responses, and middleware.
- [Database access](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/guides/orm/): Portable ORM models, queries, relations, and transactions.
- [Background jobs](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/guides/jobs/): Portable job contracts and SQL-backed workers.
- [React and JSX](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/guides/react/): Browser applications in TypeScript mode.
- [Browser HTTP](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/guides/browser-http/): Typed frontend HTTP clients.
- [Packages](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/guides/packages/): Distributed TypeRB packages and native dependencies.

## Tooling and implementation

- [AI-assisted development](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/ai-assisted-development/): A reliable tool loop for coding agents.
- [Compiler development](https://github.com/type-rb/type-rb/blob/main/docs/development.md): Compiler architecture and contribution workflow.
- [Current status](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/status/): Implemented features and known limits.

## Optional

- [Roadmap](https://type-rb.github.io/docs/roadmap/): Direction beyond the current alpha.
- [Playground](https://type-rb.github.io/play/): Evaluate isolated TypeRB scratch source in a browser.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/type-rb/type-rb): Compiler, packages, editor support, and documentation.
